messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected in dedicated-us-west-2 pool (p99 latency > 2s for 5m). Impact: streaming stalls / increased tail latency. Auto-escalation: page oncall.eng.
mira (eng-oncall): on it. paging in, grabbing dashboards. Which pool id? any customer-facing errors?
sam (eng-sre): seeing queue depth spike on pool 'dedicated-usw2-42' — backlog at 240 requests, worker ready=2, desired=8 but autoscaler shows "pending" for new instances. Customers seeing streaming stalls (clients report partial streams then timeouts). link: https://grafana.redwood/in/dedicated/pools?orgId=1&pool=dedicated-usw2-42
mira (eng-oncall): thx. rolling up logs. adding jun and tess. @tess can you surface any high-touch customers on that pool?
tess (prod-support): ryan reported 3 large customers on that pool (acme, finlytics, chatly). Notified CS to prepare comms. No formal incident page yet.
jun (eng-runtime): digging into autoscaler events. Looks like the warmup hook for new nodes failed repeatedly due to container image pull timeouts to our private registry. Error: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` in the node-init logs. New nodes stuck in bootstrapping -> not joining the pool so desired capacity didn't materialize.
sam (eng-sre): copy. that would explain pending state. any recent cert rotation or registry change? devops-bot, any automated changes in the last 30m?
devops-bot: Deploy hook: registry cert rotation scheduled at 1782507600. Status: completed. No rollback detected. Notifying infra team.
mira (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) Manual scale: spawn prewarmed instances from a stable image (older tag) 2) Route new traffic to fallback region us-east-1 for non-sensitive tenants 3) Reduce default batch size to lower per-request tail latency 4) Short-term enable hosted fallback for streaming for affected customers
jun (eng-runtime): I can manual scale. running manual command now:

```
# spawn 6 prewarmed GPUs using stable image
rctl capacity spawn --pool dedicated-usw2-42 --image redwood/runtime:stable-20260210 --count 6 --prewarm
```

Logs: `spawn accepted -> instance-init -> pulling image redwood/runtime:stable-20260210` (starting)
sam (eng-sre): also lowering batch size on that pool to 4 from 16 via config flag to reduce tail. Command:

```
rctl pool update dedicated-usw2-42 --max-batch-size=4
```

Applied.
mira (eng-oncall): tess/ryan coordinate customer comms. mark affected tenants and enable hosted fallback where allowed.
tess (prod-support): sent comms to ACME + Finlytics + Chatly. Offering temporary routing to fallbacks. ACME asked for ETA, telling them ~15-30m.
sam (eng-sre): note: streaming stalls drop immediately as new prewarmed instances begin to join. p95 trending down but p99 still high. Current p99 = 2.8s -> was 4.9s. backlog 120.
jun (eng-runtime): containers are joining but a subset still fail image pull due to cert issue. workaround: pin to `stable-20260210` image hosted on mirror registry `mirror.redwood.internal` which uses existing CA. Doing that for remaining spawns.
jun (eng-runtime): running mirror spawn now:

```
rctl capacity spawn --pool dedicated-usw2-42 --image mirror.redwood.internal/redwood/runtime:stable-20260210 --count 3 --prewarm
```

Started. Monitoring join events.
mira (eng-oncall): routing change: enabling regional routing policy to send new sessions for non-enterprise tenants to us-east-1. Command: `rctl routing set --policy region-fallback --from=us-west-2 --to=us-east-1 --filter=non-enterprise`
sam (eng-sre): ramp down spike: p95=430ms, p99=1.5s. streaming errors reported dropping by ~80%. queue depth 30 and falling.
ryan (sales-ops): heads-up: ACME accepted fallback for now. They'll escalate if anything else.
mira (eng-oncall): next: postmortem notes to collect: autoscaler warmup timeout config (currently 600s), registry cert rotation sequencing, prewarm pool size defaults, and a fallback policy gap for enterprise customers. Also include runbook change: autoscaler should prefer mirror registry on cert errors.
sam (eng-sre): creating temporary incident channel `#inc-1782507890-dedicated-sat` for followups and customer RCA. Will attach timelines + metrics.
jun (eng-runtime): finalizing fix: infra will rollback cert chain on registry and reissue with proper CA chain. ETA ~45m. Suggest we increase burst capacity config and lower autoscaler scale cooldown so next spike recovers faster.
mira (eng-oncall): handoff in 30m to next oncall @sam. Current state: degraded -> recovering. Key mitigations performed: manual prewarm spawn (9 instances), batch size reduced, region routing fallback enabled, hosted fallback enabled for specific customers, CS informed. Remaining work: registry cert fix + update autoscaler warmup/cooldown params.
tess (prod-support): I'll keep CS on the thread and update customers at T+30. Documenting workaround steps for support playbook.
sam (eng-sre): acknowledged. I'll take over after mira goes offline for handoff. Will coordinate with infra to ensure registry rollout is validated before we return to normal ops. :+1:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=recovering, severity=sev2, impacted_tenants=["acme","finlytics","chatly"], started=1782507890, est_mitigation=1782509790
mira (eng-oncall): thanks team. good ops. switching to monitoring-only and handing to @sam. Mira out."
